sources.title: Pharmacy Council of India approved institutions: D.Pharm, B.Pharm, Pharm.D and M.Pharm lists, 2026-27 decisions

note: Institutions on the Pharmacy Council of India's approved lists at pci.gov.in (Approved Institutes menu: D.Pharm and B.Pharm u/s 12 and only-for-conduct lists, Pharm.D and M.Pharm lists), keyed by PCI's own institution code. PCI publishes no separate address or management type: its name column often runs on into the address, so the name is kept up to the end of its institution phrase and the rest is the address, with the PIN, the district (only where written as 'Dist X') and the city (the town written before the PIN) read from it; names shared by several institutions carry their place. Intake appears only inside PCI's free-text decision, so seats are filled only where that decision states an intake for an approval covering 2026-27 (for example 'Extend approval upto 2026-2027 academic session for 60 admissions', a first-year grant for 2026-27, or a raise in intake from 2026-27); decisions that give no intake, or whose stated approval ends before 2026-27, leave seats null. Courses PCI approved only from 2027-28 are left out. M.Pharm specialisations are listed as branches where PCI names them; the M.Pharm total is filled only when every specialisation has a stated intake. Pharm.D (Post Baccalaureate) and the B.Pharm (Practice) bridge course are not included. The university is the examining authority PCI lists for the degree courses, reduced to the body's official name; values that name no identifiable university or board are left empty.
